notes: 整理说明：(1) 这份卷里只有「四.英译汉」「五.汉译英」两篇语篇是题目正文；选词填空、完形填空、术语翻译及阐释（都带解析）属非语篇题型，本 JSON 结构只承载成篇材料，未收录；题型说明与评分维度表也未收录。(2) 两篇的官方参考译文就是「解析：」之后那段文字，已按段填入 reference：英译汉原文 5 段对译文 5 段，汉译英原文 2 段对译文 2 段。(3) PDF 抽取在阿拉伯数字两侧留下空格 9 处（如「2023 年前 4 个月」「13.32 万亿元」），照录未改。(4) 汉译英这篇与 2023 年真题第二大题、2026 年样题汉译英是同一段材料，但官方英文版本不止一个：本卷 reference 用的是本卷自带的解析版；2023 真题答案里是另一个措辞不同的版本（已整理成 exams-src/2023-past-paper.json 的「语篇二」），两者不能混用。(5) 英译汉原文末句以「social inclusion」结尾且没有句号，属抽取原样，未补。(6) sourceFile 的目录与文件名是照 2023 样题的写法推定的（原始抽取文件名是 _2024_英语组笔译赛项校赛_省赛样题_.txt），入库前宜与实际下载的文件名核对。

articles.title: 2024 年官方样题 · 英译汉：国际体育促进发展与和平日（联合国，校赛难度样题）
articles.text:
The International Day of Sport for Development and Peace (IDSDP), which takes place annually on April 6, presents an opportunity to recognize the positive role sport and physical activity play in communities and in people’s lives across the globe.

The global theme for 2024 is “Sport for the Promotion of Peaceful and Inclusive Societies”.

In observance of the International Day, on April 4 an event at UN Headquarters in New York will focus on how prominent sporting bodies engage in partnerships to make positive impacts for people and the environments in which they operate. It will bring together members of the international sporting community — including members of the United Nations Football for the Goals initiative — to share best practices, discuss challenges, and explore collaborative opportunities to drive positive social change and contribute to global efforts towards sustainable development and peace.

The United Nations has long recognized the power and universality of sport, using it to unite individuals and groups through supporting sport for development efforts, participating in events from the global to the grassroots level, and developing its own sports-related campaigns and initiatives.

Sport has proven to be a cost-effective and flexible tool in promoting peace and development objectives. In the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development sport’s role for social progress is further acknowledged. Sport is also an important enabler of sustainable development. We recognize the growing contribution of sport to the realization of development and peace in its promotion of tolerance and respect and the contributions it makes to the empowerment of women and of young people, individuals and communities as well as to health, education and social inclusion
articles.reference:
每年的 4 月 6 日，国际体育促进发展与和平日（IDSDP）为我们提供了一个机会，让我们认识到体育和身体活动在全球社区和人们生活中所发挥的积极作用。

2024 年的全球主题是“体育促进和平与包容性社会”。

为纪念国际体育促进发展与和平日，4 月 4 日，纽约联合国总部将举行一场活动，重点讨论著名体育机构如何通过合作伙伴关系对人们和他们所处的环境产生积极影响。活动将汇集国际体育界的成员，包括联合国“足球促进目标”倡议的成员，共同分享最佳实践，讨论挑战，并探索合作机会，以推动积极的社会变革，助力全球可持续发展与和平的努力。

联合国长期以来一直认识到体育的力量和普遍性，通过支持体育促进发展的努力，参与从全球到基层的各种活动，开展自身的体育相关活动和倡议，来团结个人和群体。

体育已被证明是一个在促进和平与发展目标方面具有成本效益和灵活性的工具。在《2030 年可持续发展议程》中，体育在社会进步中的作用得到了进一步认可。体育也是可持续发展的重要推动者。我们认识到体育在推广宽容与尊重、促进妇女和年轻人的赋权、个人和社区的赋权以及健康、教育和社会包容目标方面对发展与和平实现的日益重要的贡献。

articles.title: 2024 年官方样题 · 汉译英：海关总署 2023 年前 4 个月外贸数据（校赛难度样题）
articles.text:
海关总署发布的数据显示，2023 年前 4 个月，我国进出口总值 13.32 万亿元，同比增长 5.8%，进出口延续了向好态势。外贸进出口展现出较强韧性，为全年实现外贸促稳提质打下了基础。值得一提的是，今年前 4 个月，有进出口实绩的民营企业数量同比增加了 8.9%，为拓宽就业渠道、稳定就业大盘发挥了积极作用。

外贸平稳向好，得益于我国产业链水平不断提升。高技术、高附加值、引领绿色转型的产品领跑出口，表明我国外贸新动能不断培育壮大，更折射出供给侧结构性改革下，中国制造业迈向高端化、智能化、绿色化的坚实足迹。依靠科技创新与低碳转型，“中国制造”不断塑造和积累国际竞争新优势，中国经济高质量发展活力强劲。
articles.reference:
According to data released by the General Administration of Customs, China's total import and export value in the first four months of 2023 was 13.32 trillion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 5.8%, continuing the positive trend in foreign trade. The strong resilience of foreign trade has laid a foundation for achieving the goal of stabilizing and improving the quality of foreign trade throughout the year. Notably, the number of private enterprises with actual import and export performance increased by 8.9% year-on-year in the first four months, playing a positive role in broadening employment channels and stabilizing the overall employment situation.

The steady and positive trend in foreign trade is attributed to the continuous improvement of China's industrial chain. High-tech, high-value-added products, and those leading the green transition have spearheaded exports, indicating the continuous growth of new driving forces in China's foreign trade. This also reflects the solid progress of China's manufacturing industry towards high-end, intelligent, and green development under supply-side structural reforms.
